description: Chuck Bartowski is pulled from an ordinary life into government espionage after classified intelligence is embedded in his brain, forcing him to balance the Buy More, family and a dangerous partnership with Sarah Walker and John Casey.

s01e01.description: Chuck opens an email from former friend Bryce Larkin and unwittingly downloads the government’s Intersect intelligence database into his brain, making him the reluctant responsibility of CIA agent Sarah Walker and NSA agent John Casey.

s01e02.description: Chuck learns there may be a doctor capable of removing the Intersect from his head, but the doctor is killed and Chuck must decide whether Sarah or Casey can actually be trusted.

s01e03.description: Chuck is sent on his first real undercover mission to identify an arms dealer while also competing with Harry Tang for the assistant-manager job at the Buy More.

s01e04.description: Sarah’s glamorous spy friend Carina recruits the team to steal a diamond being used to finance terrorism, while Chuck tries to separate Sarah’s cover identity from the woman behind it.

s01e05.description: A Chinese intelligence officer asks Chuck for help rescuing her kidnapped brother, forcing him to choose between official orders and intervening in a mission the government wants abandoned.

s01e06.description: Chuck meets a brilliant young government technologist whose life resembles his own and must decide whether to help him escape or turn him over, while Halloween strains Chuck and Morgan’s friendship.

s01e07.description: A mission sends Chuck back to Stanford, where he discovers the truth about Bryce’s role in getting him expelled and learns that the betrayal may actually have been an attempt to protect him.

s01e08.description: Chuck begins dating sandwich-shop owner Lou just as a poison specialist uses truth serum to obtain nuclear-launch information, forcing Chuck, Sarah and Casey into a race for the antidote.

s01e09.description: Chuck’s relationship with Lou becomes complicated when her family business is linked to smugglers, while Sarah struggles with jealousy and Morgan’s romance with Anna develops.

s01e10.description: Bryce unexpectedly returns alive and insists he was never a rogue agent, forcing Chuck to confront Sarah and Bryce’s shared past while helping them uncover who really betrayed the intelligence community.

s01e11.description: Chuck and Sarah pose as a married couple to investigate a politically connected counterfeiter operating from his yacht, while Morgan and Anna accidentally wander into the mission’s danger.

s01e12.description: Casey discovers that the Russian arms dealer the team is targeting is engaged to Ilsa, a woman he once loved and believed dead, forcing him to confront an old life he never resolved.

s01e13.description: A theft at the Buy More exposes the CIA surveillance surrounding Chuck and raises fears that his cover has been compromised, leaving the government ready to relocate him just as Ellie’s engagement becomes real.
